summary: Every price source available to this session without a login or a payment, with its fields checked against a real row rather than remembered.

sources.name: Databento EQUS.MINI one-minute bars, 60 large-cap symbols
sources.origin: already downloaded locally at /home/openclaw/.openclaw/research-data/databento/opening-auctions/selected60_2023-01_to_2026-08/, extracted to parquet by scripts/research/todo_111_round2_extract_minutes.py
sources.notes: Bars are stamped at the START of the minute. EQUS.MINI is roughly 20% of the national tape, so a bar's high and low can understate the true range and miss a touch; XNYS.PILLAR below is the second opinion on every touch.

sources.name: Databento XNYS.PILLAR one-minute bars, the same 60 symbols
sources.origin: same local download, same extraction script
sources.notes: A result that holds on only one of the two feeds is not a result.

sources.name: DoltHub post-no-preference/options weekly end-of-day option chains
sources.origin: cloned free with the dolt CLI, no login, no key
sources.notes: Real bid and ask, but one snapshot a week after the close. It cannot see whether an option touched +20% before -20% inside a week, so the option half of the finish line cannot be measured on it.

sources.name: DoltHub post-no-preference/stocks whole-US-market daily prices, delisted names included
sources.origin: cloned free with the dolt CLI, no login, no key
sources.sampleOutput: select min(date), max(date) from ohlcv returns 2011-01-03 and 2026-09-01; rows are keyed by act_symbol and date, used only to pick which names to look at, never to decide an exit
sources.notes: Daily bars cannot decide a first touch and are never used for an exit in this mission.

sources.name: data/options-dx-2023 quarterly zips
sources.sampleOutput: every file is exactly 2618 bytes - these are failed downloads, not data
sources.notes: Listed so no later step mistakes them for an intraday option source.

gapForTheOwner: There is no intraday option price here. Until the owner buys one or completes a login, the option half of the finish line cannot be tested at all. Every option candidate is parked for that decision.
facts: 40,278,360 one-minute bars across 120 parquet files, two independent feeds of the same 60 symbols
the share half of the finish line is fully testable today with no login and no cost
the option half is blocked on data the owner has to decide about
